svg.title: Who may call each endpoint
svg.desc: Who may call each endpoint: 10 rows compared on 5 columns. Who may call each of the 10 endpoints of the Parcelpoint tracking API, by security scheme, scope, and role, imported from its OpenAPI document. Columns: No sign-in, bearer, shipments:write, carrierKey, webhooks:write. - GET /shipments (List shipments): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Denied; webhooks:write: Allowed. - POST /shipments (Create a shipment): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Denied; webhooks:write: Denied. - GET /shipments/{id} (Get a shipment): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Denied; webhooks:write: Allowed. - DELETE /shipments/{id} (Cancel a shipment): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Denied; webhooks:write: Denied. - GET /shipments/{id}/label (Download the label PDF): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Denied; webhooks:write: Allowed. - GET /parcels/{code} (Track a parcel): No sign-in: Allowed; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Allowed; webhooks:write: Allowed. - GET /parcels/{code}/events (List a parcel's events): No sign-in: Allowed; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Allowed; webhooks:write: Allowed. - POST /carrier-events (Receive an event from a carrier): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Denied; shipments:write: Denied; carrierKey: Allowed; webhooks:write: Denied. - GET /webhooks (List webhooks): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Allowed; carrierKey: Denied; webhooks:write: Allowed. - POST /webhooks (Add a webhook): No sign-in: Denied; bearer: Allowed; shipments:write: Denied; carrierKey: Denied; webhooks:write: Allowed.
